UP Seat-Sharing Talks Heat Up Amidst Alliance Discussions

Discussions regarding seat-sharing for the Uttar Pradesh 2027 elections are intensifying between the Congress and Samajwadi Party (SP). Akhilesh Yadav is set to commence his PDA Rath Yatra from Rae Bareli, a constituency historically associated with Rahul Gandhi, amidst these ongoing seat allocation talks. Shivpal Yadav has stated that decisions on seat distribution will be made by the national presidents of both parties. Separately, Sunil Singh, national president of Lok Dal, met with Congress leader Rahul Gandhi, signaling potential alliance formations ahead of the UP elections.
